elements.name: Ungroup and regroup a ribbon command family

steps.name: a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model Work Features panel contains a grouped "Plane" command
the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Ungroup Commands from Drop-Down Menu"
the user opens the compact Work Features panel
separate plane command buttons are visible including "Offset from Plane" and "Three Points"
the user right-clicks "Plane" and selects "Group Commands into Drop-Down Menu"
the user opens the Work Features panel again
the plane choices are represented by a grouped "Plane" control
